title: seseli nudum var. purpurascens
intro: Seseli nudum var. purpurascens, commonly known as Mountain Fennel, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, aiding in respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fennel include its ability to relieve coughs, colds, and fever, as well as its use as a diuretic and carminative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
